exam.title: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS recommends basic AI familiarity, strategic awareness of relevant AWS frameworks and tools, and about six months working with or alongside AI initiatives. No coding, AWS implementation experience, or other AWS certification is required.

objective_coverage.objective_group: AI Strategy and Business Value Creation
AI Governance and Responsible AI Leadership
Business Readiness, Leadership, and AI Transformation

review.notes: The initial September 1, 2026 four-domain beta blueprint was reconciled with detailed domain pages, the live certification page and launch post before September 29 delivery. The guide explicitly distinguishes the 170-minute, 85-question beta from the detailed guide's 130-minute standard-duration statement and labels GA details pending. Three scenarios, eight document-based labs and 36 original checks cover solution-type/data decisions; use-case portfolios, build/buy/partner, baselines, TCO/ROI, metrics and durable advantage; responsible-AI tradeoffs, governance/risk tiers and lifecycle evidence; readiness, change, workforce adoption and scaling gates. All 16 URLs are cataloged: 13 reachable and ISO/O'Reilly/Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Exact AWS resources are separated from adjacent material, the official practice exam is unavailable during beta, and no recalled questions are used.
